text:
Released v1.0.38 (all tests green, 4,091 passed):
https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.38
It holds everything shipped today: faster bid desk, API manager fixes, sharp-confirmed bid step-down (v1.0.36/37), plus this fix: the API card no longer shows red 'every key refused' when the latest key check was accepted. Still open: BoltOdds' lines socket is refused, which I haven't diagnosed yet.
